text:
Ivy: Flagging follow-ups from the postmortem: missing spans, aggregation drift, and recurring ETL lag. Need owners + concrete ETAs. Tracker: https://rwd.internal/obs/fixboard

Samir: I'll take aggregation. Hypothesis: late-arriving events + retry duplication. Short-term: dedupe by event_id at ingestion and run a 7-day backfill sample. ETA: RCA + patch in 3 days; backfill after canary.

Tanya: I'll own ETL lag pattern. Initial mitigation: reduce parallel consumers during high-contention window and add jitter to retry backoff. ETA for staging test: 48h.

Arjun: I'll handle span instrumentation. Quick win: preserve trace headers across retries and add a drop-rate metric. Small FF patch ready, canary after tests (~24h).

Maya (observability): Please add firm due dates in the tracker today. Two requirements before merge: 1) regression test for late-arriving event that previously caused miscounts; 2) rollout/rollback plan documented in PR.

Samir: noted. Example backfill dry-run command I will use: ./bin/backfill --job=recompute --from=2026-03-01 --to=2026-03-07 --sample=0.05. Will post runtime/cost after dry-run.

Arjun: patch open: https://rwd.internal/pull/span-retry-fix. FF gating included. Added Grafana panel for span_drop_rate; alert at >0.4% for 10m.

incident-bot: tickets created: OBS-1830 (agg dedupe), OBS-1831 (span propagation), OBS-1832 (etl concurrency). Weekly check-ins scheduled Mondays 09:30 PT.

Maya (observability): Good. Keep this thread for daily status notes until closure. If any canary shows anomaly, tag @oncall immediately.

Samir: will post backfill dry-run results tonight.

Tanya: staging run shows queue depth improved with reduced parallelism; planning controlled prod change during low-traffic window.

Ivy: thanks team, please update tracker and ping me for final remediation review once canaries + backfill are green.
